lines.say: Every night at three oh seven, your whole city gets up in its sleep.
You wake up. Everyone on your street is walking. Eyes closed.
They all walk toward the tower, in perfect step.
Rule one. Do not wake anyone. Rule two. Walk like them.
Doris from six C walks past. Her eyes are shut. She's holding her rent.
They aren't sleepwalking. They're working the night shift. For the tower. Unpaid.
Would you wake them up? Write it in the comments.
